newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Colombia's president Samper reports big oil strike.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's president Samper reports big oil strike.

text.p: Colombian president Ernesto Samper said Wednesday state oil company Ecopetrol struck oil in an exploration northeast of the capital Bogota which could turn out to be one of the largest discoveries in the country in the past 20 years.
A recent exploration near the coast found possible reserves of 700 million barrels, Samper told a press briefing at the end of his four-day visit to the United Nations.
If that preliminary information is confirmed, it is "lilkely to be one of the largest deposits discovered in Colombia in the past 20 years," he said.
"We are waiting for confirmation as the subsequent layers are explored. But I repeat that this initial information is reliable as far as I have been told," he added.
